problem_statement:
Intermittent failures with ServerResponse.outputStream() and static file serving ## Environment Details * Helidon Version: 4.4.0 * Helidon SE * JDK version: 25 * OS: Macos 26 / Linux something (GitHub Actions env) ---------- ## Problem Description I've seen two maybe related problems while using outputStream(). The same issues seem to affect `helidon-webserver-static-content`. See Steps to reproduce below for details. If using chunked transfer, I occasionally see "missing CR" or "Malformed encoding found in chunked-encoding" or something similar depending on client. If sending content-length header, the transfer occasionally just gets stuck completely. `StaticContentFeature` does this, so it is also affected. 100MB files trigger the problems more often, but I've managed to reproduce them also with 10MB files. These have been tested with multiple client (`curl`, `java.net.http.HttpClient` and `HttpURLConnection`). On server side I get the following trace: ``` Caused by: java.io.UncheckedIOException: java.io.IOException: Broken pipe at io.helidon.common.socket.NioSocket.write(NioSocket.java:150) at io.helidon.common.socket.SocketWriter.writeNow(SocketWriter.java:81) at io.helidon.common.socket.SocketWriterDirect.write(SocketWriterDirect.java:43) at io.helidon.webserver.http1.Http1ServerResponse$BlockingOutputStream.writeChunked(Http1ServerResponse.java:818) at io.helidon.webserver.http1.Http1ServerResponse$BlockingOutputStream.write(Http1ServerResponse.java:744) at io.helidon.webserver.http1.Http1ServerResponse$BlockingOutputStream.write(Http1ServerResponse.java:579) at java.base/java.io.BufferedOutputStream.write(BufferedOutputStream.java:183) at io.helidon.webserver.http1.Http1ServerResponse$ClosingBufferedOutputStream.write(Http1ServerResponse.java:869) ... Caused by: java.io.IOException: Broken pipe at java.base/sun.nio.ch.SocketDispatcher.write0(Native Method) at java.base/sun.nio.ch.SocketDispatcher.write(SocketDispatcher.java:65) at java.base/sun.nio.ch.IOUtil.writeFromNativeBuffer(IOUtil.java:137) at java.base/sun.nio.ch.IOUtil.write(IOUtil.java:102) at java.base/sun.nio.ch.IOUtil.write(IOUtil.java:58) at java.base/sun.nio.ch.SocketChannelImpl.implWrite(SocketChannelImpl.java:562) at java.base/sun.nio.ch.SocketChannelImpl.write(SocketChannelImpl.java:614) at io.helidon.common.socket.NioSocket.write(NioSocket.java:147) ... 21 more ``` But I'm not sure whether this is actually before or after client has already encountered the error and closed the connection. curl's error ``` curl 'http://localhost:8080/dynamic' > foo % Total % Received % Xferd Average Speed Time Time Time Current Dload Upload Total Spent Left Speed 100 6144k 0 6144k 0 0 113M 0 --:--:-- --:--:-- --:--:-- 113M curl: (56) Malformed encoding found in chunked-encoding ``` and HttpURLConnections's ``` Exception in thread "main" java.io.IOException: missing CR at java.base/sun.net.www.http.ChunkedInputStream.processRaw(ChunkedInputStream.java:406) at java.base/sun.net.www.http.ChunkedInputStream.readAheadBlocking(ChunkedInputStream.java:574) at java.base/sun.net.www.http.ChunkedInputStream.readAhead(ChunkedInputStream.java:611) at java.base/sun.net.www.http.ChunkedInputStream.read(ChunkedInputStream.java:705) at java.base/java.io.FilterInputStream.read(FilterInputStream.java:119) at java.base/sun.net.www.protocol.http.HttpURLConnection$HttpInputStream.read(HttpURLConnection.java:3308) at java.base/sun.net.www.protocol.http.HttpURLConnection$HttpInputStream.read(HttpURLConnection.java:3301) ``` ## Steps to reproduce Here's a sample program that provides * `/fixed` -> content length header, gets stuck * `/chunked` -> CR failure * `/dynamic` -> CR failure, no file system used to rule that out * `/static` -> same as `/fixed` but through `StaticContentFeature` ```java import io.helidon.http.HeaderNames; import io.helidon.webserver.WebServer; import io.helidon.webserver.staticcontent.StaticContentFeature; import java.io.IOException; import java.io.OutputStream; import java.nio.file.Files; import java.nio.file.Path; public class Main { static void main() throws Exception { var path = Files.createTempFile("helidon-output-test", null); path.toFile().deleteOnExit(); var size = 100_000_000; fillTestFile(path, size); WebServer.builder() .port(8080) .routing(routing -> { routing.any("/fixed", (_, res) -> { res.status(200); res.header(HeaderNames.CONTENT_TYPE_NAME, "octet-stream"); res.contentLength(size); try (var out = res.outputStream(); var in = Files.newInputStream(path)) { in.transferTo(out); } }); routing.any("/chunked", (_, res) -> { res.status(200); res.header(HeaderNames.CONTENT_TYPE_NAME, "octet-stream"); try (var out = res.outputStream(); var in = Files.newInputStream(path)) { in.transferTo(out); } }); routing.any("/dynamic", (_, res) -> { res.status(200); res.header(HeaderNames.CONTENT_TYPE_NAME, "octet-stream"); try (var out = res.outputStream()) { fillOutput(out, size); } }); }) .addFeature(StaticContentFeature.builder() .addPath(p -> p.location(path).context("/static")) .build()) .build() .start(); } private static void fillOutput(OutputStream out, long size) throws IOException { var source = "xy".repeat(524_288).getBytes(); var remaining = size; while (remaining > 0) { var chunk = (int) Math.min(source.length, remaining); out.write(source, 0, chunk); remaining -= chunk; } } private static void fillTestFile(Path path, long size) throws IOException { try (var os = Files.newOutputStream(path)) { fillOutput(os, size); } } } ``` Malformed chunked body after upgrading from 4.3.4 to 4.4.0 ## Environment Details * Helidon Version: 4.4.0 * Helidon MP * JDK version: 25.0.2 * OS: Alpaquita Linux Container ---------- ## Problem Description After upgrading our service from Helidon **4.3.4** to **4.4.0**, we started seeing rare, nondeterministic failures in service-to-service integrations. The failures happen only occasionally and are difficult to reproduce locally, but they can be triggered during load testing in the deployed environment. The client receives errors indicating that the HTTP/1.1 chunked response is malformed, for example: ``` java.io.IOException: Chunk header size too long: 2050 at java.net.http/jdk.internal.net.http.HttpClientImpl.send(HttpClientImpl.java:938) at java.net.http/jdk.internal.net.http.HttpClientFacade.send(HttpClientFacade.java:133) at WorkflowEmployeesSummaryTestRunner.executeScenarioRequests(WorkflowEmployeesSummaryTestRunner.java:157) at TestRunnerUtils.lambda$executeScenario$0(TestRunnerUtils.java:61) at java.base/java.lang.VirtualThread.run(VirtualThread.java:456) Caused by: java.io.IOException: Chunk header size too long: 2050 at java.net.http/jdk.internal.net.http.ResponseContent$ChunkedBodyParser.tryReadChunkLen(ResponseContent.java:256) at java.net.http/jdk.internal.net.http.ResponseContent$ChunkedBodyParser.tryReadOneHunk(ResponseContent.java:346) at java.net.http/jdk.internal.net.http.ResponseContent$ChunkedBodyParser.tryPushOneHunk(ResponseContent.java:435) at java.net.http/jdk.internal.net.http.ResponseContent$ChunkedBodyParser.accept(ResponseContent.java:204) at java.net.http/jdk.internal.net.http.ResponseContent$ChunkedBodyParser.accept(ResponseContent.java:131) at java.net.http/jdk.internal.net.http.Http1Response$BodyReader.handle(Http1Response.java:708) at java.net.http/jdk.internal.net.http.Http1Response$BodyReader.handle(Http1Response.java:636) at java.net.http/jdk.internal.net.http.Http1Response$Receiver.accept(Http1Response.java:528) at java.net.http/jdk.internal.net.http.Http1Response$BodyReader.tryAsyncReceive(Http1Response.java:666) at java.net.http/jdk.internal.net.http.Http1AsyncReceiver.flush(Http1AsyncReceiver.java:233) at java.net.http/jdk.internal.net.http.common.SequentialScheduler$LockingRestartableTask.run(SequentialScheduler.java:182) at java.net.http/jdk.internal.net.http.common.SequentialScheduler$CompleteRestartableTask.run(SequentialScheduler.java:149) at java.net.http/jdk.internal.net.http.common.SequentialScheduler$SchedulableTask.run(SequentialScheduler.java:207) at java.base/java.util.concurrent.ThreadPerTaskExecutor$TaskRunner.run(ThreadPerTaskExecutor.java:291) ... 1 more Done executing all scenarios in 30160ms, now waiting extra for remaining requests... Finished executing scenarios: 1500 with all requests count: 1486 with avg scenario time: 34.624ms, min scenario time: 26ms, max scenario time: 171ms, avg request time: 34.241588156123825ms, min request time: 26ms, max request time: 96ms ``` We also sometimes see: ``` java.io.IOException: Illegal character in chunk size: 110 java.io.IOException: Illegal character in chunk size: 114 java.io.IOException: Illegal character in chunk size: 115 ``` When trying to use `mitmproxy` for gathering information about http responses issues it returns to the client given body in place of IOException issued by standard JDK HTTP Client: ``` 502 Bad Gateway

502 Bad Gateway

ProtocolException("Error in HTTP connection: HttpSyntaxException('Malformed chunked body')")

502 Bad Gateway

502 Bad Gateway

ProtocolException("Error in HTTP connection: HttpSyntaxException('Malformed chunked body')")

``` These failures started only after the upgrade to **4.4.0**. We did not observe them on **4.3.4**. ## Steps to reproduce This is not easily reproducible locally, but we can trigger it in the deployed environment with load testing. 1. Deploy the Helidon MP service on version 4.4.0 2. Execute load against the affected endpoint 3. Example test parameters: target RPS: 50 duration: 30 seconds Example output from one run: ``` Now executing scenario users count: 1500 with requests per scenario: 1 and target RPS: 50 for 30 seconds. java.io.IOException: Chunk header size too long: 2050 ... Done executing all scenarios in 30160ms, now waiting extra for remaining requests... Finished executing scenarios: 1500 with all requests count: 1486 with avg scenario time: 34.624ms, min scenario time: 26ms, max scenario time: 171ms, avg request time: 34.241588156123825ms, min request time: 26ms, max request time: 96ms ```
